random_consumption_rule: logging and serialization must not call the route RNG
event_definition: one real 64-proposal GA update, or the final smaller update within a lineage quota; no synthetic generations
saved_objects: complete population before and after every real update
all audited proposals and acceptance status
route, run, support, lineage, update and proposal identities
parent identities, crossover and mutation decisions

using logging to consume random numbers
replacing or overwriting historical formal results
presenting a non-identical replay as the original trajectory
